name: core--litellm-auth-setup
description: LiteLLM master key generated and configured for auth

implementation.change: Generate master key if missing, read it, set in docker-compose environment and Prometheus auth

checks: File permissions are 0600 (readable only by root)
Master key is base64-encoded 48-byte random value
headroom_litellm_master_key fact is set in Ansible
Prometheus authorization uses master key credentials
